title: ExtConvParticipantIntegDef - Tooling API
description: Represents the integration configuration for external conversation participants, used for communication between Salesforce and external messaging platforms. This object is available in API version 66.0 and later.

AccountKey.description: The encrypted JSON format key for secure storage of authentication credentials for external bot API calls.

BotProvider.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
BotProvider.description: The provider of bot integration that handles authentication and request and response logic. Possible value: Custom

ChannelMode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ChannelMode.description: Possible values for channel type are: Messaging Voice The default value is Messaging.

ClientIdentifier.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ClientIdentifier.description: The API client ID of the bot provider.

DeveloperName.description: The unique name of the object in the API.

Language.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update

ManageableState.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
ManageableState.description: The manageable state of the specified component that’s contained in a package. Possible values are: beta deleted deprecated deprecatedEditable installed installedEditable released unmanaged

NamespacePrefix.description: If it's part of a managed package, the namespace of the package that contains integration definition for the external conversation participant.

ProjectIdentifier.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ProjectIdentifier.description: The ID of the project in the provider framework to scope API calls and resource access.

Status.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Status.description: The status of the integration. Possible values are: Active Deleted Inactive The default value is Active.

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<xsd:simpleType name="BotProvider">
  <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string">
    <xsd:enumeration value="Custom"/>
    <xsd:enumeration value="GoogleCCAI"/>
  </xsd:restriction>
</xsd:simpleType>
<xsd:simpleType name="ChannelMode">
  <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string">
    <xsd:enumeration value="Messaging"/>
    <xsd:enumeration value="Voice"/>
  </xsd:restriction>
</xsd:simpleType>
<xsd:complexType name="ExtConvParticipantIntegDef">
  <xsd:complexContent>
    <xsd:extension base="mns:Metadata">
      <xsd:sequence>
        <xsd:element name="accountKey" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="botProvider" minOccurs="0" type="tns:BotProvider"/>
        <xsd:element name="channelMode" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ChannelMode"/>
        <xsd:element name="clientIdentifier" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="connectedAppOauthLink" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="conversationVendorInfo" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="customEventPayloadField" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="customEventTypeField" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="customPlatformEvent" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="developerName" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="externalConversationBotDefs" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded" type="mns:ExternalConversationBotDef"/>
        <xsd:element name="masterLabel" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="projectIdentifier" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="status" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ExtConvParticipantIntegDefStatus"/>
      </xsd:sequence>
    </xsd:extension>
  </xsd:complexContent>
</xsd:complexType>
<xsd:simpleType name="ExtConvParticipantIntegDefStatus">
  <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string">
    <xsd:enumeration value="Active"/>
    <xsd:enumeration value="Inactive"/>
    <xsd:enumeration value="Deleted"/>
  </xsd:restriction>
</xsd:simpleType>
```
